run_rmsnorm_hf_correctness_tests: run parametrized pytest tests to verify rmsnorm_hf kernel correctness across batch sizes and hidden sizes
test_rmsnorm_hf_out_parameter: test the rmsnorm_hf kernel output parameter by verifying in-place tensor assignment and correctness
test_rmsnorm_hf_semantics_regression: test that rmsnorm_hf follows HF LlamaRMSNorm cast-before-multiply semantics instead of old SGL fp32-multiply-then-cast
test_rmsnorm_hf_empty_input_handling: test that rmsnorm_hf correctly handles empty input tensors with zero num_tokens
test_is_supported_rmsnorm_hf_hidden_size: test the is_supported_rmsnorm_hf_hidden_size function to validate which hidden sizes are supported by the kernel
